reviews.x: My husband is currently deployed in Kuwait and I included this in his most recent care package. I initially just bought it cause I liked the marketing of this item, but we ended up loving it. He's addicted to CarMex, as it's hot and dry over there, and he reported to me this was carmex x1000 - so he was pleased to say the least. It's a huge tube, easily 3x the size of regular chapstick... I will be purchasing more when he runs out.

The tube is ginormous so it lasts forever, has a great minty flavor with quality ingredients, and is SPF 15. Oh, it also doesn't melt if you leave it in the car. I am currently in the middle of the desert in Kuwait and this stuff has been  a life saver in preventing sun damage and chapped lips in the 120 degree F weather.

I live in Phoenix and have been looking for a lip balm that doesn't melt if left in the car.  I accidentally left the lip balm in my car today and it did not melt.  The temperature outside was 102. The product was softer than usual but it did not loose its shape.  This is by far the best lip balm I have used.  I would recommend it to anyone.

Chapstick is SIGNIFICANTLY larger than it appears in the online pictures. Your friends will likely laugh their butts off when they see it. It's practically a gag gift. Chapstick works and feels great, though. I carry it with me everywhere now. Can't wear pants with tight pockets, though.  Update: Melts in the car :(  I bought this chapstick after Googling "chapstick that won't melt in the car". The description and reviews led me to believe I was safe. reviews.t: Bought it in desperation - bought more because my family loves it.
reviews.x: I bought this lip balm at a conference in Nashville because it was the only lip balm I could find.  I was hesitant because I am a Bert's Bees junkie.  It is wonderful.  My husband ended up stealing it and uses it in his pickup because it doesn't melt in the sun.  I ordered 2 more tubes for my 19 year old son when he told me that he had tried his dads and loved it.  Great product and lots of it for the money.  This is a HUGE tube that will last for a long, long time.

reviews.t: This stuff is great! I am constantly losing my lip balm and ...
reviews.x: This stuff is great! I am constantly losing my lip balm and am very particular about what kinds that I use. Duke Cannon's product is an excellent solution to this problem as the chapstick is huge. The mint flavor is nice and reminds me of candy canes. The product does not melt in my pocket, as advertised, and works wonders on my lips when I am dehydrated. Duke Cannon also manufactures this product in the USA, which I fully support. Excellent product.

reviews.t: My favorite Chapstick. It's large so I don't loose it ...
reviews.x: My favorite Chapstick. It's large so I don't loose it as much and it lasts a long time compared to old faithfuls like burtsbees. I like that is pretty matte but if feels really soft and supple. It stays on, and no strong smell, it's a very pleasant balm.  No complaints really.

Had this in my pocket for a few months on the Florida heat and it didn't melt. It's bigger than a regular chapstick, so it lasts longer I don't know if it's $10 bigger though. But, it's a good product, I would buy more.

reviews.t: Great Lip Balm, Horrible Sticker Situation
reviews.x: I really like this lip balm, it's absolutely my favorite! My son also loves it. I had to take a star off because of having two extra stickers here on Amazon. The label is smooth but now I have pieces of a torn sticker that doesn't want to come off. I'll have to use baby oil and have at it. Great product, but the stickers are a pain!  This has never melted on me, but I don't keep it in my car, I keep it in my purse.

reviews.t: Did not survive hot summer days inside the car
reviews.x: So I live in desert climate and one of my challenges (poor me, I know!) is that (a) I want to leave a lip balm in my car at all times, in case I forget to bring one from home, and (b) it gets veeeeery hot inside my car during summer times when the car is parked. Usually, if I leave lip balms in the car, they just melt all over the place or, if they stay inside their casing, their consistency changes in a way that they cannot be applied properly anymore to the lips. So I was excited to discover D

reviews.t: Changed the Ingredients. "Sunscreen" lip balm now.
reviews.x: I bought the one on the left over a year ago and as you can see it's different from the one on the right. Not as many sunblock ingredients, didn't taste like sunblock and it kept my lips nice and soft every single day. I bought another tube at Target a few months ago and happily applied as usual. Then I tasted/smelled sunblock. I checked the label and saw that it was now "Offensively Large Sunscreen Lip Balm" rather than the old one stating "Offensively Large Lip Balm". I then checked the ingred

I bought this for my husband and he loves it. It is man sized and will last a long time. He is using it now in the winter but I hear it is heat stable in the summer as well so he can leave it in the car. This tube is about three times the size of Burt's Bees lip balm. So if you want to make a man in your life happy this is the thing to buy. Chapped lips are no fun. This solves a big problem year round and is minty fresh too.  ~The Rebecca Review

No other chapsticks work like this one. It's the best. It feels perfect in my hand. It seriously is about 3 or 4 times bigger than any normal chapstick, but somehow it feels perfect. I never need to reapply it multiple times. The scent is some type of mint and it has a slight sweetness. Plus it has a tingle so you can feel it. It's simple awesome.

reviews.t: Okay, so let me start off by saying this ...
reviews.x: Okay, so let me start off by saying this things is MASSIVE. It's about the thickness of a sharpie Magnum. Definitely a bit inconvenient if you want to carry it in your pocket, but it's going in a bag so no biggie. It does what it's supposed to do, freht mint flavor, and keeps your lips from getting chapped.

For a lip balm that supposed to handle being in 125deg, it fails. It was in my car and the outside temperature was 85deg. I understand that in my car it would be hotter but I didn’t think it would melt! I would never spend $10 on lip balm...smh don’t market something if it’s not tested!

Picked this one because I saw the reviews for the blood orange one left a pinkish color. Proud to say this one doesn't. And surprise! Its enormous. About twice the size of a normal lip balm. I really love the taste, green tea that tingles a lil.

reviews.t: It lasted an entire calendar year, using everyday.
reviews.x: I got this for Christmas and it made it till the next Christmas, didn't even run out. The stick finally stripped out and wouldn't push anymore out. I have a dip can like fade in my work pants from it even!

reviews.t: The fact that it does not melt easily is another plus as I keep it in my ...
reviews.x: This stuff rocks!!! I use it daily and it lasts longer then my other "chap sticks".  The fact that it does not melt easily is another plus as I keep it in my motorcycle saddle bag.
Supersized is not the word to use. Darn thing is huge! A bit high on the wax content, but still works great and is VERY long lasting, on the lips, and in tube
Moisturizing and smells good. Not to strong of mint. It smells like Andy mint candy at Christmas!
This has become my favorite lip balm.  Nice minty flavor and feels cool when I put it on.
Great stuff! Not greasy, and the big stick will last a LONG time.

I got this because at the time I was working in a datacenter and those place have cold aisles and hot aisles. The cold aisles may be around 50F while the hot were commonly around 115F. I was constantly melting my chapstick while working there and needed something I wouldn't have to worry about. The Duck Cannon Balm saved me. No more worries about chapstick rapidly changing temperatures. After I stopped working in the datacenter it was still handy since I occasionally forgot my chapstick in my po

I have been looking for a lip balm I can leave in my car and not have it melt everywhere. I set it in the door cubby so it's easy access because I need it constantly. I've tried some brands that only kinda melted, I tried some brands that melted to the point of emptying the tube in to my door and requiring cleanup. reviews.t: LOVE (Green Label) Duke Cannon Lip Balm
reviews.x: LOVE (Green Label) Duke Cannon Lip Balm!  Bought some at hospital gift shop and this is my 3rd time ordering multiples from Amazon.  I don't wear lipstick because they're too drying & glosses are too sticky. This beats all the others chapsticks I've tried- including Trader Joe's - which I love. Lasts for. ev. er. Minty smell, refreshing on (seriously), no color but a touch of a shine.  I'm not a fan of the Black Label- too stiff, and... orange (on).  Oh- tube is big enough to find BEFORE throwin

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the large size of the tube, noting it lasts a long time and is hard to lose.
Many reviewers report the balm does not melt when left in a hot car or pocket, though a few say it did melt in extreme heat.
The minty flavor and scent are commonly described as pleasant.
Several reviewers mention the balm keeps lips soft and prevents chapping, including in dry desert conditions.
A few reviewers complain about the oversized tube being inconvenient for pockets or looking like a gag gift, and one notes a changed formula.
